International Awards and Honours

Nobel Prize

  • Established by the will of Alfred Nobel (died 1896).
  • Six fields: Peace, Physics, Chemistry, Medicine, Literature (started 1901); Economics (started 1968).
  • Ceremony held in Stockholm on 10 December (Peace Prize awarded in Oslo).
  • Not awarded posthumously, except if the laureate dies before the ceremony.
